narr: Keling, biz ishlab chiqarish jarayonini ko'rib chiqaylik. Bugungi mavzu - bu check valve yoki boshqaruv klapanini ishlab chiqarish bosqichlari.
Ishlab chiqarish jarayonini tushuntirishda asosiy e'tibor bosqichlarning o'ziga qaratilgan, kim bajargani emas. Bu jarayonlarni tavsirlashda present simple passive zamonidan foydalaniladi.
Keling, birinchi topshiriqni ko'rib chiqaylik. Chizmalardagi jarayonlarni to'g'ri tartibda raqamlang.

data.heading: 1-topshiriq — Ishlab chiqarish jarayonini tartiblash
data.problem: Chizmalarga qarang. Check valve ishlab chiqarish jarayonining tavsifini tinglang. Bosqichlarga to'g'ri tartibda raqam bering.
steps: Valve korpusi quyiladi (casting)
Korpus tokar mashinasida ishlanadi (turning)
Teshiklar quyiladi (drilling)
Qismlar bir-biriga bolt bilan biriktiriladi (bolting)
Valve bo'yaladi (painting)
Ish tekshiriladi (inspection)
data.result: To'g'ri tartib: casting → turning → drilling → bolting → painting → inspection

narr: Ko'rib turganingizdek, birinchi bosqichda valve korpusi quyiladi. Keyin u tokar mashinasida ishlanadi, ya'ni kerakli shakl beriladi.
Shundan so'ng teshiklar quyiladi va qismlar bir-biriga bolt bilan biriktiriladi.
Jarayonning keyingi bosqichida valve bo'yaladi va oxirida ish tekshiriladi.

data.heading: 2-topshiriq — Savollar
steps: 1-savol: Ma'ruzachi jarayonni tushuntirishda qaysi fe'l zamonini ishlatadi?
2-savol: Bu zamon nega ishlatilgan?
3-savol: Ma'ruzachi jarayon bosqichlarining tartibini tushuntirishda qanday so'zlarni ishlatadi?
data.result: 1: Hozirgi zamondagi oddiy passiv (present simple passive). 2: Chunki jarayon bosqichlari muhim, kim bajargani emas. 3: Ketma-ketlik so'zlari: first, then, next, after that, finally.

narr: Birinchi savolga javob: ma'ruzachi hozirgi zamondagi oddiy passiv zamonidan foydalangan. Bu is/are + past participle shaklida bo'ladi.
Ikkinchi savolga javob: bu zamon ishlatiladi, chunki ishlab chiqarish jarayonida muhim narsa - bu bosqichlarning o'zi, ularni bajargan shaxs emas.
Uchinchi savolga javob: ketma-ketlikni bildiruvchi so'zlardan foydalanilgan: first, then, next, after that, finally.

data.heading: 3-topshiriq — Og'zaki nutq
data.problem: Juftliklarda ishlang. A talaba A tarqatma varag'idan, B talaba B tarqatma varag'idan foydalanib, ishlab chiqarish jarayonini tushuntiring.
steps: Present simple passivga ketma-ketlik so'zlarini qo'shib to'liq tavsib bering

Namunaviy javob: First, the body of the valve is cast from hot metal and cooled to make the correct shape. Then it is turned on a lathe, and part of the material is removed. Next, a hole is drilled, and the parts are bolted together with a nut and a bolt. After that, the valve is painted. Finally, the work is checked carefully — the valve is inspected.
data.result: Valve ishlab chiqarish jarayoni: casting → turning → drilling → bolting → painting → inspection

narr: Endi juftliklarda ishlab, valve ishlab chiqarish jarayonini tushuntiring. Present simple passiv va ketma-ketlik so'zlaridan foydalaning.
Endi 5-hafta ma'ruzasining uchinchi qismiga o'tamiz. Bu yerda «How Is Tea Made?» maqolasini o'qib chiqamiz.

data.heading: 1-mashq — Lug'at
data.problem: O'qishdan oldin maqoladagi har bir so'zni (1–10) uning ma'nosi (A–J) bilan moslashtiring. Harfni Javob ustuniga yozing.
steps: 1 pluck (plucked) — E. to pick leaves or flowers from a plant
2 moisture — I. the small amount of water inside something
3 brew — B. to make a hot drink by pouring hot water onto tea leaves
4 wither (withering) — G. to lose water and become soft and weak
5 oxidation — D. a process in which something reacts with the air and changes colour
6 enzymes — H. natural chemicals in living things that cause changes

narr: Keling, choy tayyorlash jarayoni bilan bog'liq bo'lgan lug'at so'zlarini o'rganaylik.
Birinchi so'z 'pluck' - bu o'simlik barglari yoki gullarini terish degan ma'noni anglatadi.
Ikkinchi so'z 'moisture' - bu narsaning ichidagi suv miqdori.
Uchinchi so'z 'brew' - issiq suvni choy barglari ustiga quyib issiq ichimlik tayyorlash.
To'rtinchi so'z 'wither' - suvini yo'qotib yumshoq va zaif bo'lish jarayoni.
Beshinchi so'z 'oxidation' - narsaning havoga reaksiyasi bilan rangini o'zgartirish jarayoni.

data.heading: 1-mashq — Lug'at (cont.)
steps: 7 granules — A. very small, rough pieces, like tiny grains
8 bruise — F. to damage the surface of something by pressing or hitting it
9 grade — J. to put things in order by size, type or quality
10 tea chest — C. a large wooden box used to store and transport tea

data.heading: 2-mashq — To'g'ri yoki noto'g'ri
data.problem: Maqolani o'qing. Har bir bayonot uchun T (true) yoki F (false) deb yozing. Agar bayonot noto'g'ri bo'lsa, uni to'g'rilang.
steps: Bu mashqda maqolani o'qib berilgan bayonotlarning to'g'ri yoki noto'g'riligini aniqlashingiz kerak.
data.result: Javob kaliti: 1, 3, 4 va 8-misollar lug'at ta'riflari va 3-mashq bilan tasdiqlangan.
